Definition: a kind of locust (from its destructiveness)
BiblicalUsage: The bald locust is one of the clean insects Israel may eat, named once in the law of clean and unclean. The word is a kind of locust, and the law lists it among the flying creeping things that go on four feet. It appears once, and it is there because God names what His people may eat.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a locust in the law shows that God cares about the details of His people's daily life.
